operations.resolveAndStageConflictingFil.en: Resolve and Stage conflicting files before Continue.
operations.resolveAndStageConflictingFil.zh-CN: 请先解决冲突并暂存文件，再继续。

operations.noUnmergedFilesInGitInspectTh.en: No unmerged files in Git. Inspect the staged result before Continue; content correctness has not been verified.
operations.noUnmergedFilesInGitInspectTh.zh-CN: Git 中已无未标记的冲突文件。继续前请检查暂存结果；内容正确性尚未验证。

operations.reviewTheActiveOperationBefor.en: Review the active operation before continuing.
operations.reviewTheActiveOperationBefor.zh-CN: 请检查当前操作后继续。

operations.skipTheCurrentCommitInThisOpe.en: Skip the current commit in this operation
operations.skipTheCurrentCommitInThisOpe.zh-CN: 跳过当前操作中的提交

operations.quitEffect.en: End Cherry-pick and keep the current HEAD, working files and Index exactly as they are, including unresolved conflicts. Already applied commits remain; remaining commits will not be applied.
operations.quitEffect.zh-CN: 退出 Cherry-pick，保留当前 HEAD、工作区和暂存区的原样状态，包括未解决的冲突。已应用的提交保留，剩余提交不再应用。

operations.quitNext.en: You can then edit the files, mark and stage resolved conflicts, and create a normal commit. Continue, Skip and Abort for this Cherry-pick will no longer be available.
operations.quitNext.zh-CN: 退出后可手动编辑文件、标记并暂存处理结果，再普通提交。本次 Cherry-pick 将无法再继续、跳过或中止。
